text:
miya_sales: Quick ask  VantageHealth procurement needs a compliance bundle to finalize the PO. They specifically want a redacted SOC 2 control-matrix excerpt, an ISO27001 scope snippet if possible, a signed pentest attestation for our isolated staging environment addressed to their security lead, and a rough delta estimate for providing a private appliance (ISO/installer) vs hosted POC. Can we turn this around by Friday? @ryan_se @celeste_compliance @jay_security

ryan_se: I can run the appliance delta. Clarify format: ISO (installer) or VM image? Packaging/validation differs. Ballpark for ISO + validation and signing: $16k one-time; ongoing patching/support for the appliance $2.5k/mo. If they want us to coordinate a pentest window we can add $1.2k for ops support. I'll confirm final numbers by EOD.

celeste_compliance: For SOC2 we can provide the control-matrix excerpt and the cover/scope page. We'll redact internal hostnames, CI/CD job names and staff IDs. For ISO27001 I can include the scope statement excerpt if the customer needs it. Need ~24 hours to prepare redacted PDFs and a short note about redaction.

jay_security: Pen-test attestation: we can provide an attestation letter confirming an accredited third-party performed a penetration test of the isolated staging cluster. We will not disclose vuln reports. If VantageHealth insists their vendor run the test, require NDA addendum + POA from Legal, a scoped CIDR and a defined 3-hour window; that adds ~2 business days for approvals. Also require presigned S3 upload for findings and ephemeral creds only.

miya_sales: They asked if the attestation can list a CIDR. Is it acceptable to say "CIDR available out-of-band" instead of embedding it in the letter?

jay_security: Prefer that. We can provide CIDR via secure channel after NDA approval. Embedding CIDRs in signed letters triggers extra Legal review.

ops_bot: Ticket EVID-9021 created: "VantageHealth proofpack". Checklist attached: SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 snippet, pentest attestation, NDA addendum template, network isolation diagram. Owner: miya_sales.

celeste_compliance: I'll prepare redacted SOC2 + ISO snippet and drop a private S3 link tomorrow AM.

ryan_se: Minimal network sketch for the packet (ASCII):

[Internet] -> Edge LB -> Maintenance Jumpbox -> Isolated Staging Cluster (no prod peering)
Management plane on separate VLAN; monitoring exported read-only to S3.

jay_security: Draft attestation snippet for Legal review:

"[Redwood Inference Letterhead]
To: Security Lead, VantageHealth
Re: Penetration Test Attestation  Staging Environment
Redwood Inference confirms that an accredited third-party performed a penetration test limited to the isolated staging environment used for the VantageHealth POC. The assessment was restricted to the staging cluster and ingress points. Detailed vulnerability reports and remediation specifics are withheld; a high-level summary can be provided under NDA. This attestation does not authorize access to production systems.
Signed,
[Director of Security]"

miya_sales: Great. Next steps: Ryan  confirm final appliance delta by EOD; Celeste  SOC2+ISO snippets tomorrow AM; Jay  route attestation to Legal today. I'll feed procurement a nonbinding estimate to keep them moving. Thanks team :thumbsup:
